prompt: A human cleric in white robes with gold-thread embroidery stands in a side profile facing east, one hand raised holding a glowing golden holy symbol toward a snarling horned demon. The demon recoils, its dark crimson body breaking apart and dissolving upward into a scatter of white motes and light, leaving no corpse, slowly fading out of existence. Soft holy radiance flows back from the demon to the cleric, haloing her. The only source of light in the scene is this warm white-gold healing glow. The background is the dim stone interior of a chapel with arched windows.

Streams of warm life-light pour from the dissolving demon back into the cleric. Both figures are fully visible head to knee, the same size. The only source of light is the white-gold radiance. The background is a shadowy ruined cathedral nave.
